title: The exhaustion hold says "outcome is unknown" for a dispatch_budget_exhausted local hold that sent nothing
outcome:
EngramSpentInvocation::of_cause (engram_begin_preparation_retry.rs, from w-ac230a24d0d8) classifies every code that is neither a certificate nor a local preparation code as Unknown. That includes dispatch_budget_exhausted, a local hold in which the budget ran out before evaluate or transmission (engram_host_adapter.rs about :8711 and :8745) and nothing was sent. So the hold tells the operator that an unsent invocation has an unknown outcome. That is safe but inaccurate, and it can read as a possible duplicate write.
Fix: classify local NotStarted causes as NotSent, ideally derived from the card's causal_failure remote_application rather than from the code string. Cover it with a test of the spent hold after a dispatch_budget_exhausted park.
acceptance: The exhaustion hold says "outcome is unknown" for a dispatch_budget_exhausted local hold that sent nothing is done
